ancestry_detail: European (Italian, Chianti geographic area, Tuscany)
platform_version: ELISA / RIA / Bio-Rad Multiplex / Clinical Chemistry
imputation_panel: Genotyped only (Illumina Infinium HumanHap550)
transformation: Log (lnskew0) or Box-Cox (bcskew0) transformation (36 continuous traits); median/detectability dichotomization (6 traits)
covariates: Age, sex (EIGENSTRAT genomic control lambda)
harmonisation_notes: Coordinates verified via Ensembl as NCBI35/hg17 (e.g. rs505922 = chr9:133178783). 40/42 assays measured in serum, TSH in EDTA plasma, LPA in citrate plasma (Table S1); FT3/FT4 are thyroid hormones mapped to TG in Table S3a. Targeted 1-2 SNP replication in WATTS, NFBC1966, Health ABC (Table S2).

ancestry_detail: CEPH Utah residents with ancestry from northern and western Europe (CEU; 16 parents and 8 children)
imputation_panel: Genotyped only (HapMap)
transformation: Log standardized abundance
covariates: None
harmonisation_notes: GRCh36/NCBI36 (dbSNP b130). Main-text Tables I & II report lead rsID, Chr, P, FDR, and r2 without alleles or Beta/SE.

ancestry_detail: Healthy elderly European individuals
imputation_panel: 1000G Phase 1 Interim EUR (June 2011)
transformation: Log-transformed, residualized on age, sex, site
covariates: Age, sex, study site, 5 genetic PCs
harmonisation_notes: Main-text Table 1 reports R/E alleles and Beta (SE) for 60 lead cis-pQTLs; Suppl Table 4 reports 2,016 cis-SNPs (Beta, MAF).

ancestry_detail: European ancestry individuals with chronic obstructive pulmonary disease
platform_version: BioVendor ELISA + Aushon/Thermo SearchLight Protein Array
imputation_panel: Genotyped only (Illumina HumanHap550)
transformation: Natural log (ln); untransformed for fibrinogen
covariates: Age, sex, smoking status, pack-years, 7 genetic PCs
harmonisation_notes: Primary GWAS Tables 3 & E2 use GRCh37; follow-up Table E5 (Beta/CI for 8 SNPs) uses GRCh36.

ancestry_detail: European (Northern Swedish, Karesuando KA06 and Soppero KA09 parishes)
imputation_panel: 1000 Genomes Phase I integrated variant set (March 2012, b37)
transformation: Rank-based inverse normal transformation per individual and per plate
covariates: Age, BMI, technical plate/run factors, kinship matrix
harmonisation_notes: Peptide-level cis-pQTL GWAS (989 peptides across 163 proteins); Table S3 reports minor-allele Beta, SE, P, and frequency without allele letters.

ancestry_detail: 41 CEU, 22 YRI, and 9 ASN (8 CHB, 1 JPT) unrelated HapMap LCLs
imputation_panel: Genotyped only (HapMap Phase III r3)
transformation: Mean log2(TMT reporter ratio to GM12878) across biological replicates
covariates: Population labels (CEU, YRI), sex (chrX)
harmonisation_notes: Combined 3-population cis-pQTL scan (+/-20 kb, MAF>10%) in 72 unrelated HapMap LCLs (from 95 profiled across 5,953 ENSG proteins). Table S8 (supplement-9.xls) reports FDR<10% cis-pQTLs on GRCh36/hg18 with Beta and P-values (no SE or allele frequency).

ancestry_detail: Utah residents with Northern and Western European ancestry (CEU)
imputation_panel: Genotyped only (HapMap Phase III r3)
transformation: Mean log2(TMT reporter ratio to GM12878) across biological replicates
covariates: Sex (chrX)
harmonisation_notes: CEU-specific cis-pQTL scan (+/-20 kb, MAF>10%) in 41 unrelated HapMap CEU LCLs; FDR<10% cis-pQTLs in Table S8 (supplement-9.xls).

ancestry_detail: Yoruba in Ibadan, Nigeria (YRI)
imputation_panel: Genotyped only (HapMap Phase III r3)
transformation: Mean log2(TMT reporter ratio to GM12878) across biological replicates
covariates: Sex (chrX)
harmonisation_notes: YRI-specific cis-pQTL scan (+/-20 kb, MAF>10%) in 22 unrelated HapMap YRI LCLs; FDR<10% cis-pQTLs in Table S8 (supplement-9.xls).

ancestry_detail: Caucasian ancestry (healthy Danish blood donors, Rigshospitalet, Copenhagen)
imputation_panel: Genotyped only (Affymetrix GeneChip Human Mapping 500K)
transformation: Natural logarithm (ln)
covariates: Sex
harmonisation_notes: Ex vivo 24h E. coli LPS-stimulated whole blood culture supernatant. Genome-wide Affymetrix 500K discovery scan in N=130 donors (Table S1 top 152 SNPs on GRCh36/hg18 with MAF, Alleles, P-value; no Beta/SE); 152 and 9 candidate SNPs followed up in Stage 1 (N=186) and Stage 2 (N=400), combined N=716.

ancestry_detail: Non-Hispanic Caucasian participants
platform_version: Myriad RBM Human DiscoveryMAP v1.0 (Luminex xMAP)
imputation_panel: Genotyped only (Illumina Human610-Quad)
transformation: Log10 transformation on skewed analytes (ADNI QC; Table S1)
covariates: Age, sex, education, baseline clinical diagnosis (CN/MCI/AD)
harmonisation_notes: Cis-only scan (+/-500 kb around 137 genes; 1,992 SNPs) across 132 QC-passing RBM analytes (131 proteins + cortisol) in ADNI (N=521); 107 significant hits tested for replication in IMAS (N=59). Although prose/Fig S1 cite hg18, Tables 3-4 and Tables S3-S4 report GRCh37/hg19 coordinates (verified via rs4129267=chr1:154426264, rs429358=chr19:45411941).

ancestry_detail: Yoruba in Ibadan, Nigeria (YRI)
platform_version: Micro-Western Array (MWA) + Reverse Phase Protein Array (RPPA)
imputation_panel: 1000 Genomes Phase 1 (June 2011, YRI, BIMBAM v1.0)
transformation: Background-subtracted, beta-actin/GAPDH normalized, batch-corrected, quantile-normalized to N(0,1)
covariates: None (unrelated YRI LCLs; passage/freeze-thaw mixed model for cellular traits)
harmonisation_notes: Companion paper to Hause et al. 2014 (PMID:25087611) analyzing the exact same 68 YRI LCL 441-antibody (391-protein) dataset on GRCh36/hg18; Stark et al. (published April 2014) reports primary genome-wide pQTLs overlapping cisplatin/paclitaxel cytotoxicity & apoptosis dQTLs (P<1e-4, Table S4).

ancestry_detail: Yoruba in Ibadan, Nigeria (YRI)
platform_version: Micro-Western Array (MWA) + Reverse Phase Protein Array (RPPA)
imputation_panel: 1000 Genomes Phase 1 (June 2011, YRI, BIMBAM v1.0)
transformation: Inverse normal transformation of ComBat batch-corrected log2(intensity / beta-actin or GAPDH)
covariates: None (ComBat batch-adjusted; unadjusted model selected over SVA)
harmonisation_notes: Full text + authentic AJHG supplements (mmc1..mmc13) verified. Companion paper to Stark et al. 2014 (PMID:24699359) on the shared 68 YRI LCL 441-antibody (234 MWA + 207 RPLA; 391 protein isoforms) dataset (+17 YRI LCL replication for 20 proteins in mmc10.xlsx). Authentic mmc9.xlsx (Table S9) preserves all 171 FDR<0.20 discovery pQTLs (12 cis, 159 trans; T-stat, R, R2, P-value on GRCh36/hg18). Note: EBI BioStudies mirror S-EPMC4129400 contains mis-indexed 2020 files; download supplements directly from AJHG DOI.

ancestry_detail: European (Northern Swedish, Karesuando KA06 and Soppero KA09 parishes)
imputation_panel: 1000 Genomes Phase I (March 2012, b37) + in-house 100-exome WES/ExomeChip panel
transformation: Rank-based inverse normal transformation (GenABEL rntransform) of covariate-adjusted log2(ddCq) residuals
covariates: Biomarker-specific Bonferroni-significant clinical/lifestyle covariates (from 158 tested) + genomic kinship matrix
harmonisation_notes: Genome-wide summary statistics openly available on SciLifeLab Figshare (g000001.gzip) for the 14 GWAS-significant proteins; top hits in Suppl Data 3.

ancestry_detail: European ancestry (non-Hispanic Caucasian PCA cluster)
imputation_panel: 1000 Genomes (June 2012 release, Beagle v3.3.1)
transformation: Log10 / Shapiro-Wilk normal-adjusted CSF analyte levels
covariates: Age, sex, 2 EIGENSOFT ancestry PCs
harmonisation_notes: Sample-size weighted METAL meta-analysis of ADNI (N=308) and Knight ADRC (N=266) across 59 CSF RBM analytes (58 proteins + cortisol). Table S1 reports 335 study-wide significant variants on GRCh37/hg19 (verified via rs2228145=chr1:154426970) with P-values, +/- directions, and MAF (no numeric Beta/SE).

ancestry_detail: Yoruba in Ibadan, Nigeria (YRI)
imputation_panel: HapMap (210 YRI) + 1000 Genomes (May 2011, BIMBAM)
transformation: Log2(L/H SILAC ratio) standardized per individual and quantile-normalized to N(0,1)
covariates: 9 protein principal components
harmonisation_notes: Cis-pQTL scan (+/-20 kb, MAF>=0.10) across 4,381 SILAC-quantified proteins in 62 HapMap YRI LCLs (online 2014-12-18, print 2015-01-30). Supplementary Data 1 shares 278 FDR<10% cis-pQTLs (ENSG, chr, hg18.pos, perm.p, snp.pvalue, snp.R.value; no rsID, alleles, or SE) and Data 3 shares 68 interaction psQTLs; raw MS in PRIDE PXD001406.

ancestry_detail: Caucasian females of north European descent
imputation_panel: 1000 Genomes Phase 1 (10/11/2010 freeze, IMPUTE v2)
transformation: Rank-normal transformation of family mixed-model residuals after regressing 10 protein PCs on log2(top-2 peptide sum)
covariates: 10 protein principal components + twin family random effect (GenABEL)
gwas_software: GenABEL + R (lm, Fisher test, 20,000 permutations, qvalue)
harmonisation_notes: Female-only TwinsUK SWATH-MS cis-pQTL scan (+/-1 kb TSS); Table S4 reports 13 FDR<0.05 cis-pQTLs.

ancestry_detail: European ancestry (ADNI and Knight ADRC EIGENSTRAT PCA)
imputation_panel: 1000 Genomes (June 2011 release, Beagle v3.3.1)
transformation: Log10 transformation and mean-zero standardization
covariates: Age, sex, AD status, first 2 ancestry PCs
harmonisation_notes: Joint one-stage GWAS across ADNI (N=506) and Knight ADRC (N=312) plus METAL sample-size weighted meta-analysis (146 QC-passing RBM analytes: 143 protein assays across 140 unique proteins + cortisol, testosterone, CA19-9). PubMed indexed this 2016-01-04 article under PMID 36647296. Tables 2-4 & S3-S5 (MOESM1_ESM.pdf) report GRCh37 coordinates, MAF, Beta, and P-value without SE; Table S6 is cited in text only and not hosted on the publisher page.

ancestry_detail: Trans-ethnic meta-analysis (611 EUR, 571 HIS/AMR, 570 CHN/EAS, 516 AFA/AFR)
platform_version: Quantitative sandwich ELISA (R&D Systems Quantikine / Bender MedSystems)
imputation_panel: Genotyped only (Affymetrix 6.0 + Illumina Exome + Cardio-MetaboChip + IBC Chip)
transformation: Log-transformed, residualized on age, sex, 3 PCs, scaled to unit variance
covariates: Age, sex, first 3 ancestry PCs
harmonisation_notes: Stouffer sample-size weighted Z trans-ethnic meta-analysis across 4 MESA ancestry strata (Table S6, P<1e-5 on GRCh37/hg19). 11/15 adhesion proteins measured in serum; 4/15 (P-selectin, RANTES, SDF-1a, TGFb-1) measured in EDTA plasma.

platform_version: Quantitative sandwich ELISA (R&D Systems Quantikine / Bender MedSystems)

transformation: Log-transformed, residualized on age, sex, 3 PCs, scaled to unit variance
covariates: Age, sex, first 3 ancestry PCs
harmonisation_notes: Multivariate canonical correlation (MQFAM) mpQTL scan in MESA EUR (Table S4 reports A1/A2 alleles, multivariate P<1e-5, and signed canonical loadings across all 15 proteins on GRCh37/hg19).

ancestry_detail: Chinese Americans (MESA CHN)
platform_version: Quantitative sandwich ELISA (R&D Systems Quantikine / Bender MedSystems)

covariates: Age, sex, first 3 ancestry PCs
harmonisation_notes: Multivariate canonical correlation (MQFAM) mpQTL scan in MESA CHN (Table S3, P<1e-5 on GRCh37/hg19).

transformation: Log-transformed, residualized on age, sex, 3 PCs, scaled to unit variance
covariates: Age, sex, first 3 ancestry PCs
harmonisation_notes: Multivariate canonical correlation (MQFAM) mpQTL scan in MESA HIS (Table S5, P<1e-5 on GRCh37/hg19).

ancestry_detail: European (Norwegian, Tromsø municipality)
platform_version: Singulex Erenna / Tethys Bioscience single-molecule sandwich ELISA
imputation_panel: 1000 Genomes Phase 3 (EUR + EAS, Beagle v4.0) + WES (N=243) / HumanExome BeadChip (N=87)
transformation: Quantile normalized to standard normal distribution (R qnorm)
covariates: Age, sex, BMI, genotyping platform, VTE case-control status, kinship matrix
harmonisation_notes: Exonic + imputed common (MAF>=1%, q.emmax) and rare (MAF<=5%, SKAT-O) cis (+/-500 kb) and trans scan across 50 gene intervals (51 serum proteins; C3 and C3b share P01024). Tables 1-3 & S7-S9 report GRCh37/b37 coordinates, Ref/Alt alleles, Alt AF, Beta, R2, and P-values (no SE).

ancestry_detail: Non-Hispanic White current and former smokers
imputation_panel: Genotyped only (Illumina OmniExpress+Exome in SPIROMICS; HumanOmniExpress in COPDGene)
transformation: Rank-based normal quantile transformation (<LLOQ imputed at 0.5*LLOQ or Tobit censored)
covariates: Age, sex, BMI, study site, smoking status, pack-years, genotype PCs (plus biomarker PC1 in SPIROMICS)
gwas_software: PLINK (v1.9) + R censReg (Tobit) + Stouffer weighted Z
harmonisation_notes: Meta-analysis of SPIROMICS (N=750; 67 EDTA plasma + 21 serum assays) and COPDGene (N=590; 88 BD P100 K2-EDTA plasma assays) across 88 QC-passing biomarkers (from 115 in S1 Table). Tables S3 (P<1e-5) & S4 (527 genome-wide pQTLs across 38 biomarkers) report GRCh37 coordinates, cohort MAF, beta/z-stat, and P-value without SE or allele letters.

ancestry_detail: European (Southern German, KORA F4 discovery; targeted replication in N=338 Arab/Asian QMDiab)
imputation_panel: Genotyped discovery (Affymetrix Axiom, 509,946 SNPs); 1000G Phase 3 v5 fine-mapping
transformation: Rank-based inverse normal transformation of linear regression residuals
covariates: Age, sex, BMI
harmonisation_notes: Active 2016 bioRxiv preprint (posted 2016-11-09; links to PMID:28240269 in search/2017). Discovery GWAS in KORA F4 (N=997; 509,946 SNPs across 1,124 QC-passing SOMAmers: 1,120 human + 4 viral); targeted replication of 462 tag-SNP pairs in QMDiab (N=338). Supplemental Data 2 (086793-3.xlsx) reports 539 Bonferroni pQTLs on GRCh37 with alleles, MAF, Beta, SE, and P-value; Data 5 (086793-6.xlsx) reports 14,647 P<1e-5 hits; interactive server at http://proteomics.gwas.eu.

ancestry_detail: European (Finnish)
imputation_panel: 1000 Genomes Phase 1 (September 2013 release, 10.7M markers)
transformation: Double rank-based inverse normal transformation (pre- and post-covariate residualization)
covariates: Age, sex, BMI, first 10 genetic PCs
harmonisation_notes: Mixed blood matrices across 3 meta-analysed cohorts: FINRISK1997 (up to N=4,608, EDTA plasma, 17 cytokines), YFS (N=2,019, serum, 41 cytokines), and FINRISK2002 (up to N=1,705, heparin plasma, 41 cytokines); combined N up to 8,293. Open genome-wide GRCh37 summary statistics (GCST004420-GCST004460; computationalmedicine.fi) report alleles, Beta, SE, P-value, and heterogeneity (no genome-wide EAF). Published online 2016-12-15; use AJHG DOI supplements (BioStudies mirror mis-indexed).

ancestry_detail: East Asian (Japanese, Western Tokyo)
imputation_panel: Genotyped only (Illumina BeadChip, 514,227 SNPs)
transformation: Rank-based (Spearman rank correlation on normalized RFU)
covariates: None
harmonisation_notes: Published online 2016-11-26 (Hum Mol Genet Jan 2017 print). Nonparametric Spearman correlation scan of 514,227 SNPs (954,703 pre-QC; cited as HumanOmni1-Quad in text, deposited as HumanOmniExpressExome-8 v1.1/v1.2 on GRCh37 in GEO GSE83708/GSE83709) across 1,126 CSF SomaScan v3 assays (excluding 2 HIV probes; 2 HPV probes also on array) in N=133 physically healthy Japanese individuals (45 psychiatrically healthy, 88 psychiatric outpatients). Tables S1 (446 genome-wide FDR<0.01 pairs) & S2 (1,001 cis +/-1 Mb FDR<0.01 pairs) report rsID, Chr, Spearman rho, P, and FDR; individual-level SNP and 1,128-protein RFU matrices openly available in NCBI GEO GSE83711.

ancestry_detail: European (Southern German, KORA F4 discovery; targeted replication in N=338 Arab/Asian QMDiab)
imputation_panel: Genotyped discovery (Affymetrix Axiom, 509,946 SNPs); 1000G Phase 3 v5 fine-mapping
transformation: Rank-based inverse normal transformation of linear regression residuals
covariates: Age, sex, BMI
harmonisation_notes: Peer-reviewed Nature Communications version superseding bioRxiv preprint suhre_2016_ppr29113 (10.1101/086793). Discovery GWAS in KORA F4 (N=997; 509,946 SNPs across 1,124 QC-passing SOMAmers: 1,120 human + 4 viral); targeted replication of 462 tag-SNP pairs in QMDiab (N=338). Supplementary Data 1 (ncomms14357-s2.xlsx) reports 539 Bonferroni pQTLs on GRCh37 with alleles, MAF, Beta, SE, and P-value; Data 5 (ncomms14357-s6.xlsx) reports 14,647 P<1e-5 hits; interactive server at http://proteomics.gwas.eu.

ancestry_detail: European (Finland, France, Italy, Netherlands, Sweden; >=3 CVD risk factors)
imputation_panel: 1000 Genomes CEU v3 (MACH 1.0; Illumina Cardio-MetaboChip + Immunochip, 5,270,624 SNPs)
transformation: Log10 transformation and linear-model residual standardization
covariates: Age, sex, recruitment centre, protein analysis batch, smoking, diabetes, hypertension
harmonisation_notes: Discovery GWAS in IMPROVE (N=3,394, EDTA plasma, 83 QC-passing Olink CVD I assays across 82 unique proteins; both BNP and NPPB map to P16860); targeted replication of 79 discovery pQTLs in NSPHS (N=976), PIVUS (N=933), and ULSAM (N=730) via METAL. Complete genome-wide GRCh37 summary statistics (1,824 per-chromosome files: CHR, SNP, BP, A1, A2, FRQ, INFO, BETA, SE, P; verified rs2847443=chr21:14595264) openly downloadable from Zenodo record 264128.

ancestry_detail: European overweight/obese adults (8 countries: Denmark, Netherlands, Czech Republic, Spain, Bulgaria, Greece, Germany, UK)
imputation_panel: 1000 Genomes EUR (Michigan Imputation Server; Illumina 660W-Quad, 4,020,654 SNPs, MAF>=5%)
transformation: Log2 transformation (baseline RFU and log2 LCD/baseline fold-change; verified against IRNT)
covariates: Age, sex, study center, genetic relationship matrix (LOCO; plus BMI-adjusted sensitivity model)
harmonisation_notes: DiOGenes weight-loss intervention trial (N=494 European overweight/obese adults; fasting plasma, tube anticoagulant not specified). 1,129 SomaScan proteins profiled at baseline and post-8-week low-calorie diet (MOESM4/MOESM5; GIF across all 1,129 scans in Suppl Fig 20); primary pQTL tables report 57 baseline pQTLs across 192 BMI-associated proteins (Tables 1-2: 34 cis, 22 trans) and 3 trans-pQTLs across 104 LCD proteins (Table 4) on GRCh37 (verified rs6444444=chr3:190346231) with minor allele, MAF, Coef, SE, and P-value.

ancestry_detail: Caucasian patients with moderate-to-severe Crohn's disease (51 individuals, 102 baseline and week-22 serum samples)
imputation_panel: 1000 Genomes (MaCH; Illumina Human610-Quadv1, 733,120 genotyped SNPs)
transformation: Rank-based inverse normal transformation of log2 serum probe intensities
covariates: Age, sex, time point (baseline vs week 22), subject random intercept
gwas_software: R (linear mixed-effects model, Wald ML test)
harmonisation_notes: Repeated-measures serum SomaScan v3 cis-pQTL study in N=51 Caucasian Crohn's disease patients from CERTIFI (102 samples: baseline and week 22; 84 CD, 88 PURSUIT UC, and 15 healthy controls profiled for aging without genotypes). S4 Table (s012.xlsx) reports 3,424 50%-FDR cis-pQTLs (41 probes at 10% FDR in Table 2) on GRCh37/hg19 with alleles, +/-1 direction, nominal P, and FDR; S11 Table (s019.xlsx) provides EAF and MAF.

ancestry_detail: European (Northern Swedish, Karesuando KA06 and Soppero KA09 parishes)
platform_version: Olink Proseek Multiplex Oncology I + CVD I 96x96
imputation_panel: 1000 Genomes Phase 3 (Oct 2014; SHAPEIT v2.5 + IMPUTE2 v2.3.2, 11,901,634 SNPs)
transformation: Rank-based inverse normal transformation of covariate-adjusted residuals
covariates: Age, sex, batch/plate, sampling year, genotyping array indicator, genomic kinship matrix
harmonisation_notes: Joint GWAS (N=961) and EWAS (N=698) across 121 QC-passing unique Olink Oncology I + CVD I protein biomarkers (from 144 assayed in Table S1) in NSPHS EDTA plasma (same NSPHS collection as Enroth et al. 2014 PMID:25147954). Tables S3, S5, and S6 report primary, secondary, and tertiary GWAS signals on GRCh37/hg19 with A1, A2, Freq1, MAF, Beta, SE, and P-value.

ancestry_detail: European ancestry (Framingham Heart Study Offspring Exam 5 discovery N=759; Swedish MDCS validation N=1,421)
imputation_panel: 1000 Genomes Phase I v3 (Aug 2012, MACH v1.0.16; Affymetrix 500K + 50K MIP) + Illumina HumanExome v1.0
transformation: Rank-based inverse normal transformation
covariates: Age, sex, pedigree random effects
harmonisation_notes: Published online 2017-12-19 (Circulation Jan 2018 print). Discovery GWAS (N=759, citrate plasma, SomaScan 1.1k) and ExomeChip single-variant/gene-burden analyses (N=746) in Framingham Heart Study Offspring Exam 5 across 156 Framingham Risk Score-correlated proteins from Ngo et al. 2016 (PMID:27444932), with targeted validation and meta-analysis in Swedish MDCS (N=1,421, EDTA plasma, SomaScan 1.3k; combined N up to 2,180). Open NIHMS936031 Tables S1-S8 report 120 GWAS pQTLs, 13 exonic pQTLs, and 28 burden genes (93 SOMAmers / 90 unique UniProt targets indexed; P<=1e-3 in dbGaP) on GRCh37.p13 with Beta, P, and EAF (no SE).

ancestry_detail: Trans-ethnic meta-analysis (1,552 European Americans and 1,872 African Americans)
platform_version: Metabolon GC-MS + UHPLC-MS/MS serum oligopeptide profiling
imputation_panel: Whole-genome sequencing (7.4x HiSeq 2000 goSNAP, 7,567,083 MAF>5% variants) + whole-exome sequencing (87x VCRome 2.1)
transformation: Natural log transformation (winsorized at 1st and 99th percentiles; <LOD imputed at minimum detected)
covariates: Age, sex, eGFR, first 3 ancestry PCs (plus measurement phase 2010 vs 2014 in African Americans)
gwas_software: R (seqMeta: single-variant + T5 burden + SKAT; meta fixed-effects inverse-variance)
harmonisation_notes: Full text and open supplements (S. Tab. 1-14) verified on GRCh37. Total N=3,424 ARIC participants (1,552 EA + 1,872 AA) had fasting serum oligopeptide profiles and either WGS or WES: N=3,137 (1,458 EA + 1,679 AA) underwent 7.4x WGS for common single-variant GWAS (7,567,083 MAF>5% variants), 4-kb sliding-window, and regulatory SKAT/T5 scans; N=3,180 (1,330 EA + 1,850 AA) underwent 87x WES for coding-gene SKAT/T5 scans. Of 25 QC-passing peptides (from 49 measured), 2 uniquely map to parent human proteins (DSGEGDFXAEGGGVR -> FGA P02671; HWESASLLR -> C3 P01024) and 23 are short dipeptides/N-acetylcarnosine. Table 1 and S. Tab. 3, 5-9, 12-14 report Alleles, MAF, ln-scale Beta, and P-value without SE.

ancestry_detail: European Americans (ARIC EA: 1,552 total; 1,458 WGS / 1,330 WES)
platform_version: Metabolon GC-MS + UHPLC-MS/MS serum oligopeptide profiling
imputation_panel: Whole-genome sequencing (7.4x HiSeq 2000 goSNAP) + whole-exome sequencing (87x VCRome 2.1)

platform_version: Metabolon GC-MS + UHPLC-MS/MS serum oligopeptide profiling

covariates: Age, sex, eGFR, first 3 ancestry PCs, measurement phase (2010 vs 2014)
harmonisation_notes: ARIC African-American stratum (1,872 total with peptides + sequencing: 1,679 in 7.4x WGS common single-variant/window scans; 1,850 in 87x WES coding-gene SKAT/T5 scans; profiled across 2010 and 2014 phases). Table 1 reports AA-specific ln-scale Beta and P-value on GRCh37 without SE.

ancestry_detail: European (German, University of Magdeburg: 189 healthy blood-donor controls and 142 schizophrenia patients)
platform_version: Myriad RBM DiscoveryMAP (190-plex; 149 post-QC, 132 with intragenic SNPs)
imputation_panel: Genotyped only (Illumina Infinium PsychArray v1.0; 308,263 post-QC SNPs, 632 intragenic cis SNPs)
transformation: Normality-checked continuous serum concentrations
covariates: Age, sex, BMI, antipsychotic medication, schizophrenia diagnosis, SNP x diagnosis interaction
harmonisation_notes: Intragenic cis-only SNP scan (632 PsychArray v1.0 SNPs within 128 encoding genes across 132 serum Myriad RBM proteins out of 149 post-QC; 190-plex DiscoveryMAP) in N=331 German participants (189 controls, 142 schizophrenia patients; University of Magdeburg). Main Tables 2-3 and Supplementary Table 2 report Beta, P, and adjusted P (without SE or bp coordinates) across 73 distinct proteins (all 73 indexed in proteins_index.tsv); Supplementary Table 1 reports Minor/Major alleles and MAF for all 632 SNPs.

ancestry_detail: Non-Hispanic White current and former smokers (COPDGene and SPIROMICS pQTL subset; 3,240 total biomarker subjects)
platform_version: Meso Scale Discovery (MSD) V-PLEX Human Cytokine/Chemokine multiplex panels
imputation_panel: COPDGene Phase 2 + SPIROMICS Core 4 GWAS genotypes
